Context: 4. Seniority of Surplus Staff and Re-deployment

- 4.7.2. Consolidated Order of Merit.When persons are selected for different posts in the same grade requiring different qualifications, the UPSC and other selecting authorities should be requested to recommend candidates in a consolidated order of merit.
- 4.7.3. Determination of Seniority.The seniority of persons appointed to such posts will be based on the order in which their names appear in the consolidated list. - Chapter 36 and OM, dated 16-9-2022.
